slate_bridge.name: Slate Discord Bridge
slate_bridge.perm.admin: See the Discord bridge's status, reload it and run its self-test
slate_bridge.cmd.reloaded: Slate Discord Bridge: config read again, reconnecting.
slate_bridge.settings.section.bot.about: The bridge of the worlds this game hosts (singleplayer, and open to LAN). A dedicated server reads its own config/slate/bridge.json. How to make the bot: the setup guide below.
slate_bridge.settings.status.tip: What the bridge of the open world is doing.
slate_bridge.settings.status.remote: On another server: its bridge is its own
slate_bridge.settings.enabled.tip: The master switch. Without a bot token and a channel nothing happens either way.
slate_bridge.settings.token.tip: The bot's password: Discord Developer Portal, your application, Bot, Reset Token, Copy. It stays in this computer's config/slate/bridge.json and is never shown here.
slate_bridge.settings.token.paste.tip: Copy the token on Discord's page, then press this: it is taken from the clipboard (which is emptied after).
slate_bridge.settings.token.paste.bad.bo: Copy it on the Developer Portal's Bot page first (Reset Token, Copy).
slate_bridge.settings.token.paste.done.b: The clipboard was emptied. Reconnect, or open a world, to use it.
slate_bridge.settings.token.clear.tip: Removes the token from this computer's config.
slate_bridge.settings.channels.tip: Ids of the Discord channels bridged both ways. With Developer Mode on (Discord settings, Advanced), right click a channel: Copy Channel ID.
slate_bridge.settings.eventChannels.tip: Where joins, deaths, advancements and the server starting and stopping are told. Empty: the chat channels.
slate_bridge.settings.integrated.tip: When a world this game hosts runs the bridge.
slate_bridge.settings.reconnect.tip: Starts the open world's bridge anew with these settings.
slate_bridge.settings.guide.tip: Making the bot, the intent it needs, inviting it, the channel ids.
slate_bridge.settings.section.to_discord: What the game tells the Discord channels.
slate_bridge.settings.chatToDiscord.tip: What players write (and /me, /say) goes to Discord under their name and face.
slate_bridge.settings.mediaToDiscord.tip: Pictures, GIFs and voice messages players send with Slate Chat go along as files.
slate_bridge.settings.filesToDiscord.tip: Other files players share with Slate Chat go along too.
slate_bridge.settings.mentionDiscordUser: @Name of somebody who wrote in the channel lately pings them on Discord. @everyone, @here and roles never ping.
slate_bridge.settings.deaths.tip: The game's death messages (when the game shows them at all).
slate_bridge.settings.serverStartStop.ti: A line when the world starts and one when it stops.
slate_bridge.settings.section.to_minecra: What the game shows of the Discord channels.
slate_bridge.settings.chatToMinecraft.ti: What is written in the chat channels shows in game.
slate_bridge.settings.mediaToMinecraft.t: Pictures, GIFs (Tenor and Giphy too) and stickers show in game: inline with Slate Chat, as a link to click without.
slate_bridge.settings.roleColors.tip: Names in the colour of the member's highest coloured role.
slate_bridge.settings.ignoreBots.tip: Messages of other bots and webhooks are not shown.
slate_bridge.settings.tag.tip: The word in brackets in front of a line from Discord; empty for none.
slate_bridge.settings.maxLines.tip: How many lines of one message show; the rest is cut.
